#The Green Pact

When the forest was young, our ancestors made a promise to it: we would not harm its living wood, nor eat anything that grows from soil. In return, the forest would hold us in its arms forever.

We keep the promise. The forest keeps it too.

#What This Means

It means our bows are made of bone and horn. It means our homes are trees grown into shape by song. It means we eat meat, all meat, and outlanders who visit for dinner sometimes leave early.

It also means that when we go to war, we go as hunters. The forest does not mind that.
